Step two of the sign-in form, in place: Finish in your browser, with Open browser again, Cancel and Use a code instead, or the device code with its countdown. A QR code appears only on TV and console. The step moves on by itself when the browser finishes.

## In each kit

No kit documents SignInHandoff here yet. Each kit adds its tab when it ships the component: the drop-in,
the styled part with its slots and restyle hooks, and the headless model.
